sources.name: chen_wan_v2
sources.title: Topological complexity of finding flex points on cubic plane curves
sources.read_extent: Entire ten-page preprint read as extracted text; conventions, all §3 formulas, lower-bound theorem and pullback hypotheses, and §6 obstruction interfaces independently checked.
uses: §6 p.8–10 context; no reliance on its stronger obstruction converse
sources.limitations: Not the 2025 published full text; original Leary calculation not independently rederived. Unused §5 metric invariance error recorded in report. A late Poincare-duality challenge to Proposition 4.2(1) is unresolved; reading/matching the theorem statement does not validate its proof.

sources.title: The Hesse pencil of plane cubic curves
sources.read_extent: Relevant §§2 and 4 (printed pp.238–241 and 246–248), including Hesse-form proof, four singular members, and Hessian group structure. Not the entire 39-page article.

sources.title: Smooth equivariant triangulations of G-manifolds for G a finite group
sources.version: Mathematische Annalen 233 (1978), 199–220; DOI 10.1007/BF01405351; official GDZ digitization
sources.read_extent: Scanned relevant theorem/definition pages visually read: printed pp.199–201 and 216–218; not the entire proof development. pdftotext yields no mathematical body; OCR supplements visuals.
sources.exact_applied_theorem: Opening p.199 theorem existence clause (1), or Theorem 3.6 p.216 with N empty: finite group acting smoothly on smooth manifold; p.201 supplies regular simplicial quotient property and second barycentric subdivision statement.
uses: regular simplicial quotient of dimension at most 7
